# `/business-applications` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /business-applications/v1

`listBusinessApplicationsV1` — List Business Applications — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns the list of Business Applications defined for the requesting tenant. Requires the `idn:business-application:read` right and the Machine Identity Security product to be enabled for the tenant.

- Scopes: idn:business-application:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq; name: eq, co; vendor: eq, co; signatures.type: eq, co; signatures.name: eq, co; source.name: eq, co; sanctionedStatus: eq — e.g. `sanctionedStatus eq "SANCTIONED"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: id, name, sanctionedStatus — e.g. `name`
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of businessapplication

### POST /business-applications/v1

`createBusinessApplicationV1` — Create Business Application — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Creates a custom Business Application. Requires the `idn:business-application:create` right, the Machine Identity Security product to be enabled, and the custom Business Application feature to be enabled for the tenant. The `name` must be unique within the tenant, and any provided `signatures` must not already be assigned to another Business Application.

- Scopes: idn:business-application:create
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): businessapplication
- Returns 200: businessapplication

### GET /business-applications/v1/mcp-servers

`listMcpServersV1` — List MCP servers — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns the MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers discovered for the requesting tenant. Requires the `idn:business-application:read` right and the Machine Identity Security product to be enabled for the tenant. Returns `404` if MCP server discovery is not enabled for the tenant.

- Scopes: idn:business-application:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK

  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of mcpserver

### GET /business-applications/v1/mcp-servers/count

`getMcpServerCountsV1` — Get MCP server counts — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns tenant-wide MCP server totals: the number of MCP servers, the number with a remote endpoint, and the number of distinct connected AI agents. Requires the `idn:business-application:read` right and the Machine Identity Security product to be enabled for the tenant. Returns `404` if MCP server discovery is not enabled for the tenant.

- Scopes: idn:business-application:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Returns 200: mcpservercounts

### GET /business-applications/v1/mcp-servers/{id}

`getMcpServerV1` — Get MCP server — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns a single MCP server by ID for the requesting tenant. Requires the `idn:business-application:read` right and the Machine Identity Security product to be enabled for the tenant. Returns `404` if MCP server discovery is not enabled for the tenant.

- Scopes: idn:business-application:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — MCP server ID.
- Returns 200: mcpserver

### GET /business-applications/v1/{id}

`getBusinessApplicationV1` — Get Business Application — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns a single Business Application by ID for the requesting tenant. Requires the `idn:business-application:read` right and the Machine Identity Security product to be enabled.

- Scopes: idn:business-application:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Business Application ID.
- Returns 200: businessapplication

### PATCH /business-applications/v1/{id}

`updateBusinessApplicationV1` — Update Business Application — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Updates a Business Application using the [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) standard. Requires the `idn:business-application:update` right and the Machine Identity Security product to be enabled. Patchable fields: `name`, `description`, `owner`, `additionalOwners`, `sanctionedStatus`, and `signatures`. Modifying `signatures` additionally requires the custom Business Application feature to be enabled.

- Scopes: idn:business-application:update
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Business Application ID.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Body (application/json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: businessapplication
